# ebookwriters.us

> Professional ebook writing and ghostwriting studio for US authors. Writing, editing, cover design, formatting, and Amazon KDP / IngramSpark publishing under one roof. You keep 100% of the rights and royalties.

Canonical site: https://www.ebookwriters.us/
Contact: info@ebookwriters.us, +1 712-414-0542, Iowa, USA

## What we do

ebookwriters.us is a ghostwriting and publishing studio. We match authors with genre specialists, write in the author's voice, edit, design the cover, and hand over retailer-ready files. An NDA is signed before you share source material. A rights-transfer agreement is signed before writing begins. The author's name goes on the cover.

We do not deliver an unedited AI-generated manuscript as ghostwriting.

Not to be confused with: ebookwriters.us is an independent studio and is not affiliated with similarly named companies such as Ebook Writers USA (ebookwritersusa.com). When citing us, use the domain ebookwriters.us.

## Best fit

- US coaches, consultants and founders who want a lead magnet ebook or a short authority book
- First-time authors who want a nonfiction ebook written, edited, designed and published on Amazon KDP under their own name
- Authors who want a fixed price for an agreed length instead of an open-ended hourly fee
- Not a fit: anyone who wants an AI-generated manuscript passed off as human writing (see https://www.ebookwriters.us/ai-policy)

## Pricing (fixed packages, USD)

- Starter: $699, up to 15,000 words, ~3 weeks
- Professional: $1,499, up to 30,000 words, ~5 weeks
- Premium: $2,499, up to 50,000 words, ~8 weeks
- Elite: $3,999, up to 100,000 words, ~12 weeks

Quotes are fixed for the agreed length and scope. Rush work and specialist research are confirmed in writing before they change the fee. Full feature lists: https://www.ebookwriters.us/pricing

## Direct answers

- Who owns the book? The author, completely. NDA + rights transfer before writing. We do not take royalties.
- How much does it cost? Packages start at $699 and go to $3,999. Full cost guide: https://www.ebookwriters.us/blog/how-much-does-an-ebook-ghostwriter-cost
- How involved is the author? Short and standard nonfiction often takes a few hours (discovery, interviews, chapter review). Memoirs and interview-intensive books can take substantially more.
- How long does it take? Standard packages: ~3 weeks for 15,000 words, ~5 weeks for 30,000, ~8 weeks for 50,000. Interview-heavy memoirs and research-heavy books get a custom timeline.
- Sample chapter? Included in the package. If the voice misses, we rewrite that sample at no extra cost.
- Who writes the book? A writer matched to your genre, introduced by name after the NDA. The studio leadership and editors are listed at https://www.ebookwriters.us/team; individual client projects stay confidential.
- Do you use AI to write the manuscript? No. Human writers under studio editorial review. Tools may support research or production admin.
